args.brief: Chapter 3 "The Duplicate": Vera still works bare-handed, having chosen against the optional glove earlier. Fin arrives in the pottery studio and produces the duplicate of the missing register page from the public records; Vera and Ash read it and establish which batch the glaze box's label refers to, so the delivery dispute is settled without opening the box. They then complete the small public demonstration with the box sealed and intact, store it on the shelf, and close the work note. No bells are rung or mentioned as sounding. End on a definite quiet stopping beat. Third-person past tense, Vera viewpoint, precise practical action.
